timing: after PHI-BUDGET-SENSITIVITY generation but before opening or analysing any minimal-sensitivity outcome
purpose: Integrate an already prospectively frozen, complete Phi-4 4-bit completion-budget sensitivity without making another model call.

analysis_lock.main_contrast: historical Phi-4 4-bit C_self 700 tokens versus Phi-4 4-bit C_self 2048 tokens on the same fixed 96 worlds
analysis_lock.full_known_descriptive: report all 400 prospectively frozen known-family worlds separately
analysis_lock.heldout_descriptive: report all 100 prospectively frozen held-out worlds only as supplementary sensitivity evidence

interpretation_rules: This condition is not compute-matched to historical Phi-4 C_self.
No extra candidate slot, representation attempt, intervention, repair, or hidden information was introduced.
A large gain would require narrowing the original conclusion to acknowledge completion-budget sensitivity.
More executable plans without later-gate gain would identify serialization as a confound but not recover useful representation proposal.
Null or contradictory outcomes must be retained.
The n=96 extraction is a paired sensitivity view, not a replacement confirmatory population.
